cycles.method: Measured under ot_emu --mkii (the ColdFire port; emulator, not hardware), executed ColdFire instructions per key event, not chip cycles. SCENE + YES (the Part apply, unchanged in 0.2.0): 8,268,814 on 0.2.0's image (MAIN OS c625bbd1…, verify.py's worst case, 201 writes, frame engine off; 0.1.0 measured 8,268,075 the same way) and 11,083,553 for the blend at fader 64 with every scene byte of all eight tracks locked (231 writes, frame engine on, interrupts in the window included), measured on 0.1.0's image on 20 Oct 2026 and not repeated: that code path did not change. TRIG + SCENE (new in 0.2.0), on 0.2.0's image, from the last scene key's release to the toast with all 16 trigs held and every slot locked in both scenes: 66,929 (blend), 98,681 (SCENE A), 19,444 (a repeat that changes nothing). No static bound: the Part apply's cost is stock's page-1 writer 0x40054cd8 (76 to 1,404,162 instructions per write in one apply), which nothing in this repository bounds; 0.1.0's owner waiver covers only 0.1.0's source. Budget: 100 ms at 266 MHz, a key-press responsiveness target, not a measured limit.

load.method: Emulator, not hardware: ot_emu --mkii --dsp (the ColdFire port, built from the upstream:tools Octabam checkout 67e5ea37), 20 Oct 2026. Two native static-stock images from this source: CF METER + CF METER IDLE + the stock effects (upstream Octabam's probe, private, not in Modwerk), and the same plus APPLY SCENE; the same project (verify.py's fixture with T8 FX2 = CF METER, every scene byte of all eight tracks locked in both scenes except T8's FX2 page), transport playing, crossfader 64, 10 s of the same MIDI flood on both (one three-byte message per ms: notes on and off and CCs on channels 1-8 and 11, about 1,000 a second, plus clock at 240 BPM), and the same panel presses on both: SCENE A, SCENE B and both + YES about every 0.65 s (16 applies on the APPLY SCENE image). Longest frame interrupt: the largest per-cycle 'isr max' that tools/harness/cfmeter.py --dump (upstream Octabam's decoder) reads from five 2 s cycles, in the port's own time (it prices each instruction at one step, so these microseconds are not the unit's). Idle: CF METER IDLE reads 0 % on both images because the port fast-forwards main's idle park, so idle is the port's own share instead: 100 x (1 - executed instructions / (3,990 instructions per sample x elapsed samples)) over the run. The same flood without presses: longest 129.3 us stock, 129.1 us APPLY SCENE, idle 62.4 % both (the module costs nothing between presses). During the presses the longest interrupt rises to 135.9 us (stock with the same presses: 129.0 us) and idle falls by 3.7 points. Measured on 0.1.0's image (20 Oct 2026) and not repeated for 0.2.0, whose new code runs only in the SCENE key's press and release handlers, never in the frame interrupt or the MIDI path; a rerun needs the private CF METER setup and is left to the owner's call.

stress.droppedExplanation: Emulator, not hardware: ot_emu --mkii --dsp, the APPLY SCENE image and project above, 62 s of the flood (62,098 three-byte messages and 5,963 clocks), transport playing; at 7, 22, 37 and 52 s STOP with a note held on channel 1, then Part 2, PLAY and Part 1 (the Part changed by calling stock's own selection routine 0x4004a8a4, because PART + TRIG did not change it in the port's panel script); SCENE A, SCENE B or both + YES every 5 s (11 applies, up to 6,832,603 instructions each). Dropped: counted at the MIDI thread's handlers (note on, note off, CC, clock, start, stop, docs/firmware/MIDI.md); every type's handler entries were at least the messages sent (one or two more entries than sent on some types, in the stock run too: the PC watch counting an entry twice, not extra input), and none were missing. Stuck notes: every note-on had its note-off dispatched, nothing was sent to MIDI OUT, and the firmware's per-channel note bookkeeping at the end is identical to the stock image's under the same input; no samples are loaded and no MIDI track plays notes in this project, so audible stuck notes could not occur here. Hangs: frames advanced to the end and a SCENE A + YES after the final STOP was answered. Bypass and MIDI channel changes do not apply: the module has no bypass and no MIDI path. Measured on 0.1.0's image (20 Oct 2026) and not repeated for 0.2.0, whose new code runs only in the SCENE key's press and release handlers, never in the frame interrupt or the MIDI path; a rerun needs the private CF METER setup and is left to the owner's call.

hardwareEvidence.note: 0.2.0's TRIG + SCENE ran on one MKII over USB (23 Oct 2026): values read from the unit by the agent on a development twin, then the user's own run on the flashed base with playback by ear, a project save and a power cycle; nothing timed. The cycles row has no static bound; the load and stress rows are 0.1.0's ot_emu measurements. docs/MODULE_QUALIFICATION.md does not count emulator-only evidence as qualification.
